abstracts: We introduce a multimodal benchmark requiring chain-of-thought grounded in visual evidence and temporal event understanding.
Our model uses retrieval-augmented planning with verifier feedback to reduce hallucinations in image-text reasoning tasks.
We study efficient routing in mixture-of-experts transformers for long-context video and document question answering.
A new training curriculum aligns synthetic rationales with human annotations to improve faithfulness and robustness.
